title: Square watermelon shaped growth mold
body_html:
The watermelon shaped growth mold is made of high temperature resistant, high toughness and high strength plastic, and the mold is strong
Durable, can be used repeatedly for 8-10 years; mainly to limit the growth space of melons and fruits, so it plays a role in stereotyped growth; currently our company has square, heart-shaped and ingot-shaped molds that can be used for watermelon, melon, cantaloupe, grapefruit, pumpkin It can improve the ornamental and artistic quality of melons and fruits of the same size. It is suitable for farms, sightseeing picking gardens, and fruit growers who want to grow special melons.
